description: This Java class `Utils` provides shared utility methods for an Android application related to location, mapping, and wearable device interactions. It includes functions for handling permissions, formatting distances, storing and retrieving preferences, loading images from assets, managing wearable nodes, and calculating UI insets for round devices.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A utility class with static methods for location permissions, distance formatting, shared preferences management, bitmap handling, wearable device communication, and UI insets calculation.

methods.name: checkFineLocationPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has permission to access fine location data.

methods.name: formatDistanceBetween
methods.description: Calculates and formats the distance between two geographic points using the SphericalUtil library.

methods.name: storeLocation
methods.description: Stores a LatLng location into shared preferences.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Retrieves a stored location from shared preferences if permission is granted.

methods.name: storeGeofenceEnabled
methods.description: Stores the geofence trigger notification setting.

methods.name: getGeofenceEnabled
methods.description: Retrieves whether geofence notifications are enabled.

methods.name: loadBitmapFromAsset
methods.description: Synchronously loads a Bitmap from a wearable Asset; should be called on a background thread.

methods.name: createAssetFromBitmap
methods.description: Creates a wearable Asset object from a Bitmap.

methods.name: getNodes
methods.description: Gets a collection of connected wearable device nodes synchronously.

methods.name: calculateBottomInsetsOnRoundDevice
methods.description: Calculates UI insets to adjust the display for round wearable devices.
